notes: The Lyrics icon in the mini bar is the cloud layout only now: the original layout keeps its LYRICS pill and no longer shows a second Lyrics beside it.
The cloud tabs lose the hairline seam - the diagonal that cut the old dock pill was still painted across the Library and Studio tiles.
The circles get a little air: lighter icon discs, a quieter coral wash, more side padding and more room under the label before the buttons.
Long bubble labels keep both lines full and stop leaving one word alone on a line of its own.
The fade under the floating tabs spans the screen now, so a row of a list no longer stands at full contrast beside the tiles.
The now bar keeps its menu, its lyrics icon and its three transport buttons at the size 80.2 gave them; nothing moved in the bar.
